title: Minimal grid starter
prompt: Create the smallest working RevoGrid example in {framework}. Include package imports, typed row data, column definitions, mounting, and cleanup. Use only public APIs available in the installed version.

title: Package choice guide
prompt: Given these requirements: {requirements}, identify the RevoGrid Core, Pro, or Enterprise packages needed. Explain why each package is required and flag any feature that needs a commercial license.

title: Vanilla TypeScript setup
prompt: Build a Vanilla TypeScript RevoGrid setup for {use_case}. Create the element, assign columns and options, append it before setting source, and return a complete cleanup function.

title: Vue grid setup
prompt: Create a Vue 3 RevoGrid component for {use_case} using script setup and reactive data. Distinguish native wrapper props from custom-element or plugin properties and avoid direct internal DOM access.

title: React grid setup
prompt: Create a typed React RevoGrid component for {use_case}. Memoize stable column, plugin, and object configuration, show the relevant event bindings, and prevent unnecessary grid reconfiguration.

title: Angular grid setup
prompt: Create a standalone Angular RevoGrid component for {use_case}. Include the wrapper import, typed inputs, property bindings, event handlers, and any cleanup required by the current API.

title: First column model
prompt: Turn this sample row into a maintainable RevoGrid column model: {row}. Choose clear labels, widths, editability, sorting, and suitable column types, then explain each decision.

title: Editable grid baseline
prompt: Configure RevoGrid for safe inline editing of {fields}. Show how to validate changes, accept or cancel edits, update application state, and keep read-only fields protected.

title: Grid sizing diagnosis
prompt: Diagnose why this RevoGrid does not fill or shrink inside its container: {layout_code}. Provide a minimal CSS and component fix that respects flex or grid min-size constraints.

title: Theme integration
prompt: Integrate RevoGrid into this design system: {tokens}. Map light and dark surfaces, text, borders, focus, selection, and hover states without patching grid internals.

title: Accessibility baseline
prompt: Review this RevoGrid setup for keyboard access, focus visibility, labels, contrast, screen-reader context, and zoom behavior. Return prioritized fixes and concrete verification steps.

title: Responsive grid shell
prompt: Design a responsive shell for this RevoGrid: {requirements}. Keep controls reachable on narrow screens, contain horizontal overflow, and preserve a useful viewport height.

title: Loading and empty states
prompt: Add accessible loading, empty, and error states around RevoGrid for this data flow: {data_flow}. Avoid treating an empty result as a loading state and include retry behavior.

title: Reactive source updates
prompt: Show the correct way to update RevoGrid when {framework} application data changes. Preserve row identity where possible and explain when to replace source versus apply targeted updates.

title: Event wiring map
prompt: Map the RevoGrid events needed for {workflow}. For each event, show payload typing, cancellation if supported, state ownership, listener attachment, and cleanup.

title: Row headers setup
prompt: Configure RevoGrid row headers for {use_case}. Cover numbering, sizing, selection expectations, accessibility, and whether row headers should remain visible on small screens.

title: Pinned columns starter
prompt: Pin the {columns} columns in RevoGrid while keeping the remaining table scrollable. Explain width constraints, mobile behavior, and how to test alignment across pinned sections.

title: Version migration starter
prompt: Migrate this RevoGrid setup from {old_version} to {new_version}: {code}. Verify changes against local types and release notes, then provide a minimal diff and regression checklist.

title: Grid configuration audit
prompt: Audit this RevoGrid configuration: {code}. Identify obsolete, conflicting, duplicated, or unstable options and propose the smallest public-API-based cleanup.

title: Reproduction sandbox
prompt: Reduce this RevoGrid issue to a standalone reproduction in {framework}: {issue}. Include deterministic data, exact interactions, expected versus actual behavior, and no unrelated dependencies.

title: Schema to columns
prompt: Generate typed RevoGrid columns from this data schema: {schema}. Handle optional and nested fields, sensible widths, display names, editability, and reusable column types.

title: Nested field strategy
prompt: Recommend a RevoGrid data and column strategy for nested records shaped like {record}. Compare flattening, accessors, and derived display fields while keeping edits predictable.

title: Reusable column types
prompt: Create reusable RevoGrid column types for {field_kinds}. Centralize shared formatting and editing behavior, keep per-column overrides possible, and include typed usage examples.

title: Value formatter
prompt: Implement a RevoGrid formatter for {value_type} with these display rules: {rules}. Handle null, invalid, and boundary values without mutating source data.

title: Custom cell renderer
prompt: Build a lightweight RevoGrid cell renderer for {visual}. Use the supported rendering API, preserve selection and focus behavior, avoid per-cell listeners where possible, and include cleanup notes.

title: Custom cell editor
prompt: Create a RevoGrid editor for {field_type}. Define initial value, keyboard commit and cancel behavior, validation, focus handling, and how the value is written back.

title: Cell validation flow
prompt: Design validation for these RevoGrid fields: {rules}. Separate parsing from validation, prevent invalid commits, expose useful feedback, and cover paste as well as direct editing.

title: Multi-column sorting
prompt: Configure and test RevoGrid sorting for {columns}. Include null ordering, locale or numeric comparison, stable tie handling, and keeping complete row records attached.

title: Filter configuration
prompt: Implement RevoGrid filters for {fields_and_rules}. Normalize user input, handle empty values, combine conditions clearly, and keep filtering efficient on {row_count} rows.

title: External search
prompt: Add an external search control for this RevoGrid dataset: {schema}. Search selected fields case-insensitively, combine with grid filters, debounce if justified, and restore the full source cleanly.

title: Row grouping plan
prompt: Design RevoGrid row grouping for {dataset} by {group_fields}. Define group identity, labels, default expansion, aggregation needs, sorting behavior, and framework state ownership.

title: Tree data model
prompt: Transform this hierarchical domain model into a RevoGrid tree-friendly source: {data}. Preserve stable identities, parent-child order, expansion state, and lazy-loading constraints.

title: Aggregation design
prompt: Define RevoGrid aggregations for {metrics} grouped by {dimensions}. Specify null handling, precision, subtotal and grand-total placement, and tests for recalculation after edits.

title: Conditional cell properties
prompt: Apply conditional RevoGrid cell properties for these business rules: {rules}. Keep the logic data-driven, typed, testable, and free from manual DOM class mutation.

title: Row styling rules
prompt: Create maintainable RevoGrid row styling for {statuses}. Choose the supported hook or renderer, preserve theme compatibility, and avoid recomputing expensive rules for every render.

title: Async data loading
prompt: Design an async data-loading flow around RevoGrid for {api}. Cover initial load, paging or incremental fetch, cancellation, errors, duplicate requests, stable row identity, and loading indicators.

title: Targeted row updates
prompt: Update only the affected RevoGrid rows and cells for this event stream: {events}. Use the public grid or data-provider APIs, preserve viewport state, and avoid replacing the full dataset unnecessarily.

title: Clipboard data mapping
prompt: Design copy and paste mapping for these RevoGrid columns: {columns}. Handle headers, hidden or read-only fields, parsing, validation, partial failure, and user feedback.

title: Date column contract
prompt: Define a RevoGrid date column for values stored as {storage_format} and displayed in {locale}. Preserve timezone semantics, handle invalid values, and keep editing round trips lossless.

title: Column state persistence
prompt: Persist RevoGrid column order, width, pinning, sorting, and visibility for {scope}. Version the saved state, validate it on restore, and tolerate added or removed columns.

title: Selection workflow
prompt: Configure RevoGrid selection for {workflow}. Define focus, single versus range selection, row or column headers, keyboard behavior, and how application state observes changes.

title: Programmatic focus
prompt: Focus and reveal the RevoGrid cell at row {row} and column {column} after {trigger}. Use public selection and viewport APIs, wait for the correct lifecycle point, and handle missing targets.

title: Edit lifecycle guard
prompt: Implement this RevoGrid edit policy: {policy}. Show pre-edit checks, commit validation, cancellation, external persistence, optimistic failure recovery, and event ordering.

title: Keyboard navigation
prompt: Customize or verify RevoGrid keyboard navigation for {workflow}. Cover Tab, Enter, Escape, arrows, range extension, editing conflicts, and accessible focus visibility.

title: Range operation
prompt: Apply {operation} to the current RevoGrid selection. Read ranges through the supported selection API, skip protected cells, batch data updates, and report partial failures.

title: Multi-range command
prompt: Design a command that works across multiple RevoGrid ranges for {use_case}. Normalize overlaps, preserve selection, update data efficiently, and define undo boundaries.

title: Row drag workflow
prompt: Add RevoGrid row reordering for {dataset}. Enforce allowed drop rules, update the canonical source order, preserve identity, and cover filtered or grouped states.

title: Column move policy
prompt: Implement a RevoGrid column movement policy for {rules}. Prevent invalid moves across pinned or grouped regions, persist valid order, and provide regression scenarios.

title: Column resize behavior
prompt: Tune RevoGrid column resizing for {layout}. Define minimum and maximum widths, flex or autosize expectations, persistence, and behavior when the viewport narrows.

title: Context menu actions
prompt: Create context-sensitive actions for a RevoGrid cell or range: {actions}. Derive context from public events and selection state, enforce permissions, and restore focus after the menu closes.

title: Cell tooltip design
prompt: Add accessible tooltips for truncated RevoGrid values in {columns}. Avoid creating unnecessary overlays, handle scrolling and virtualization, and keep keyboard users supported.

title: Read-only policy
prompt: Enforce RevoGrid edit permissions from {permission_model}. Keep display and selection available, block keyboard and paste edits consistently, and update permissions reactively.

title: Conditional editing
prompt: Allow editing in RevoGrid only when {conditions}. Centralize the rule, explain how editors receive it, and test direct edit, keyboard entry, and paste paths.

title: Undo and redo plan
prompt: Design undo and redo for these RevoGrid mutations: {mutations}. Define transaction boundaries, inverse data, selection restoration, memory limits, and external-save interactions.

title: Row action column
prompt: Build a RevoGrid action column for {actions}. Keep buttons keyboard accessible, stop unintended selection or editing, use stable handlers, and enforce row permissions.

title: Paste sanitization
prompt: Sanitize and validate pasted RevoGrid data for {schema}. Prevent formula or markup surprises, parse locale-sensitive values, keep invalid cells unchanged, and summarize rejected input.

title: Accessible grid audit
prompt: Audit this RevoGrid interaction for WCAG-relevant keyboard, focus, semantics, announcements, contrast, touch target, and zoom issues: {implementation}. Prioritize reproducible findings.

title: Touch interaction plan
prompt: Adapt this RevoGrid workflow for touch devices: {workflow}. Address scrolling, selection, editing, resize handles, context actions, and narrow-screen controls without breaking desktop input.

title: Event sequence debugger
prompt: Trace this RevoGrid interaction bug from user input through events, providers, stores, and rendering: {symptom}. Separate observed evidence from hypotheses and propose minimal probes.

title: Workspace state restore
prompt: Restore a RevoGrid workspace containing {state}. Define initialization order for source, columns, filters, selection, and viewport so restored state is valid and does not flash or race.

title: Large dataset benchmark
prompt: Create a fair RevoGrid benchmark for {row_count} rows and {column_count} columns. Measure startup, scroll responsiveness, edit latency, memory, and update cost with reproducible data and thresholds.

title: Virtualization diagnosis
prompt: Diagnose this RevoGrid virtualization issue: {symptom}. Inspect source size, dimensions, viewport state, row and column sizing, renderers, and update patterns before proposing a fix.

title: Renderer cost review
prompt: Review these RevoGrid cell renderers for hot-path cost: {code}. Identify allocations, listeners, layout reads, unstable closures, and work that can be cached or moved outside render.

title: Batch update strategy
prompt: Design an efficient RevoGrid update strategy for {updates_per_second} updates per second. Coalesce changes, use targeted provider APIs, protect user editing, and define refresh cadence.

title: Memory usage audit
prompt: Audit this RevoGrid page for memory growth after repeated mount, scroll, edit, and unmount cycles: {code}. Check listeners, plugins, renderers, overlays, references, and cleanup.

title: Startup optimization
prompt: Reduce RevoGrid time-to-usable for {dataset}. Separate fetch, parsing, column construction, plugin setup, mounting, and first render; recommend changes backed by measurements.

title: Scroll jank investigation
prompt: Investigate RevoGrid scroll jank in {browser_and_device}. Define a profiling capture, correlate long tasks with renderers or layout, and propose the smallest measurable optimizations.

title: Variable row sizing
prompt: Evaluate whether variable row heights are appropriate for this RevoGrid content: {content}. Compare readability, measurement cost, virtualization impact, and simpler fixed-height alternatives.

title: Wide grid optimization
prompt: Optimize a RevoGrid with {column_count} columns. Review column virtualization, pinned width, renderer cost, autosizing, hidden columns, and horizontal navigation.

title: Framework reactivity audit
prompt: Audit how {framework} state updates propagate into RevoGrid: {code}. Remove accidental full-array or full-configuration churn while preserving correct reactive updates.

title: React render audit
prompt: Review this React RevoGrid component for unstable props and rerenders: {code}. Identify what should be memoized, which callbacks need stable identity, and what must remain reactive.

title: Vue reactivity audit
prompt: Review this Vue RevoGrid component for unnecessary deep reactivity or source replacement: {code}. Recommend appropriate refs, computed values, stable plugin arrays, and property bindings.

title: Angular change detection
prompt: Review this Angular RevoGrid integration for change-detection overhead: {code}. Keep inputs stable, handle grid events efficiently, and isolate high-frequency work when appropriate.

title: Dataset generator
prompt: Generate deterministic RevoGrid benchmark data matching {schema} for {row_count} rows. Include edge values, stable IDs, realistic distributions, and a seed so results are repeatable.

title: Performance trace plan
prompt: Create a browser performance-trace plan for this RevoGrid scenario: {scenario}. Specify actions, markers, metrics, representative hardware, repetitions, and how to distinguish noise from regression.

title: Formatter hot path
prompt: Optimize this RevoGrid formatter without changing output: {formatter}. Measure parsing and allocation cost, handle invalid values, and avoid premature caching that can go stale.

title: Filter latency review
prompt: Reduce filter latency for this RevoGrid dataset and predicate set: {details}. Profile normalization, debounce external input, avoid duplicate scans, and define acceptable response time.

title: Pinned section alignment
prompt: Diagnose RevoGrid header or row misalignment between pinned and scrolling sections: {reproduction}. Inspect dimension ownership, row sizing, fonts, borders, and timing rather than patching DOM offsets.

title: Unmount leak test
prompt: Write a regression test that mounts and unmounts this RevoGrid integration repeatedly: {component}. Verify listener, timer, overlay, and plugin cleanup without relying on fragile internal markup.

title: Performance regression gate
prompt: Design a stable RevoGrid performance regression gate for {workflow}. Choose metrics and tolerances, warm-up strategy, dataset, environment controls, artifact capture, and failure triage.

title: Plugin scaffold
prompt: Scaffold a RevoGrid plugin for {behavior}. Define lifecycle, public methods, configuration, provider dependencies, event cleanup, types, exports, and focused tests using existing plugin patterns.

title: Data provider extension
prompt: Implement {behavior} through RevoGrid's data provider rather than DOM inspection. Identify the owning state, supported update methods, refresh implications, and regression coverage.

title: Dimension provider task
prompt: Design this RevoGrid sizing behavior with the dimension provider: {behavior}. Explain indexes, sizes, trimmed items, viewport recalculation, lifecycle timing, and test cases.

title: Selection provider task
prompt: Implement {selection_behavior} with RevoGrid's selection provider and stores. Preserve focus, edit state, ranges, keyboard behavior, and compatibility with virtualization.

title: Column provider task
prompt: Implement {column_behavior} through RevoGrid's column provider. Cover lookup, raw column state, updates, grouping or pinning implications, and public configuration.

title: Viewport provider task
prompt: Implement {scroll_behavior} with RevoGrid's viewport provider. Avoid direct scroll mutation, account for virtual coordinates, and define lifecycle and boundary tests.

title: Plugin discovery API
prompt: Show how application code can locate and call the RevoGrid plugin {plugin_name}. Use the plugin registry or public plugin list, type the instance, and handle missing or not-yet-ready plugins.

title: Plugin listener cleanup
prompt: Audit this RevoGrid plugin for event-listener leaks: {code}. Pair every attachment with lifecycle-safe cleanup and cover reconnect or repeated initialization behavior.

title: External overlay
prompt: Build an external overlay for RevoGrid that displays {content}. Anchor it safely across scrolling and virtualization, manage focus and dismissal, and keep grid state provider-backed.

title: Shared column type
prompt: Package a reusable RevoGrid column type for {domain_value}. Combine formatter, editor, validation, defaults, overrides, exports, documentation, and contract tests.

title: Editor extension review
prompt: Review this custom RevoGrid editor: {code}. Check lifecycle, value parsing, commit and cancel keys, focus, validation, cleanup, accessibility, and compatibility with scrolling.

title: Theme extension
prompt: Create a maintainable RevoGrid theme extension for {brand}. Use supported variables and selectors, cover light and dark modes, and test focus, selection, editing, pinned areas, and disabled states.

title: Core or Pro decision
prompt: Assess whether {feature_request} belongs in RevoGrid Core, Pro, Enterprise, or application code. Compare existing capabilities, ownership, licensing, reuse, and maintenance tradeoffs.

title: Pivot configuration
prompt: Create a RevoGrid Pivot configuration for rows {rows}, columns {columns}, and values {values}. Define aggregators, totals, expansion, formatting, and validation against the installed Enterprise API.

title: Export workflow
prompt: Design a RevoGrid export workflow for {format}. Specify visible versus full data, column order, formatting, formulas, hidden fields, large-data behavior, errors, and the package required.

title: MCP implementation brief
prompt: Use the RevoGrid MCP and local source to plan {feature}. Retrieve relevant public APIs first, verify them against the installed code, identify ownership, and return a minimal implementation and test plan.

title: Framework parity review
prompt: Compare this RevoGrid example across Vanilla TypeScript, React, Vue, and Angular: {files}. Find behavioral or configuration drift and propose idiomatic equivalent fixes.

title: Plugin contract tests
prompt: Write focused contract tests for the RevoGrid plugin {plugin_name}. Cover lifecycle, configuration, provider interactions, public methods, cleanup, invalid input, and one consumer integration path.

title: Extension migration plan
prompt: Migrate this RevoGrid customization away from internal DOM or private APIs: {code}. Locate the owning provider, event, grid property, or plugin API and preserve behavior with regression tests.

title: RevoGrid change review
prompt: Review this RevoGrid change for correctness, regressions, performance, framework parity, provider ownership, public API compatibility, and missing tests. Return only actionable findings with file and line evidence.
